authentic_images_orig.notes: Authentic images from MS-COCO val2017: 2,440 train, 341 val, 343 test = 3,124 total.

mask_count.source_location: README.md 'Dataset specifications' (# masks: 2 - segmentation & bounding box)
mask_count.notes: Authors specify 2 mask types per image (segm and bbox) yielding an estimated ~6,248 masks across 3,124 authentic images. Total masks directory is 42,362,470 bytes (~40.4 MB). Exact physical file count is unverified until download receipt.

sd2_sp_images.source_location: README.md specifications (3,124 images * 2 masks * 3 batch variations = 18,744)
sd2_sp_images.notes: TGIF contains 74,976 total manipulated images across 4 sub-datasets (SD2-sp, PS-sp, SD2-fr, SDXL-fr). Each sub-dataset contains exactly 18,744 images (14,640 train, 2,046 val, 2,058 test). Total folder size in Nextcloud is 18,575,836,774 bytes (~17.3 GB reported).

split_counts.notes: Official split proportions (78.1% train, 10.9% val, 11.0% test) are strictly grouped by source image to prevent leakage.

edit_variants_per_source_id.source_location: README.md (2 masks * 3 variations in batch = 6 variants per generator sub-dataset)
edit_variants_per_source_id.notes: For SD2-sp, each authentic image has 2 masks (segm, bbox) with 3 batch variations each, generating 6 manipulated variants per source_id. Across all 4 TGIF sub-datasets, there are 24 variants per source_id.

relationship_orig_to_manipulated.value: 1 authentic : 6 edited variants in SD2-sp (1:24 across all 4 TGIF sub-datasets)
relationship_orig_to_manipulated.notes: 74,976 manipulated / 3,124 authentic = 24 total. 18,744 in SD2-sp / 3,124 authentic = 6.

mask_sharing_relation.value: One mask is shared across 3 batch variations under the same mask type (segm or bbox)
mask_sharing_relation.source_location: README.md ('each inpainting operation creates 3 variations in batch')
mask_sharing_relation.notes: Each authentic image has 1 segm mask and 1 bbox mask. Inpainting on segm mask produces 3 variations sharing that mask; inpainting on bbox mask produces 3 variations sharing that mask.

filename_convention.value: Derived from MS-COCO 12-digit image ID prefix with mask/generator/variant suffixes
filename_convention.notes: Filenames begin with MS-COCO identifier (e.g., 000000xxxxxx) to preserve source identity. Exact suffix format will be verified upon inspection of downloaded samples.

source_id_extraction_method.value: Parse leading numeric token or string preceding first delimiter '_' corresponding to MS-COCO ID
source_id_extraction_method.notes: All variant files sharing the same leading COCO image identifier are mapped to the same source_id.

download_granularity.value: Subfolder dynamic ZIP download via Nextcloud public share
download_granularity.notes: Nextcloud supports downloading individual subdirectories (masks, orig, sd2-sp) as server-side dynamically generated ZIP archives. Direct individual image URL download without fetching folder archive is unsupported for bulk dataset access.
